A way of moderating the anger or the blame at the US for continuing this unpopular, illegal, unnecessary war.

The message it sends is: Look, we’re very angry at Israel. We yell at them. We call them names. 

But policy is more important than rhetoric: Does the private yelling then change the facts on the ground?
